events.did: informed the EON board through Gabriel's control that she was stepping aside and naming Dr. Gray her successor
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel’s words came out from Helena Roy’s lips, in Helena Roy’s voice, as she informed the board that she was stepping aside, and naming Dr. Gray as her successor.

events.did: answered the board's challenge by identifying himself as a psychiatrist with a personal investment in EON
events.quote_anchor: “I’m a psychiatrist,” he answered. “One with a personal investment in your organization. And a vision for its future.”

events.did: ended the call after telling the board he looked forward to changing each of their minds
events.quote_anchor: “and I look forward to changing each of your minds,” he added, before ending the call.

events.did: asked about the on-shift soldiers, then rose to his feet and rolled up his sleeves
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel rose to his feet, rolling up his sleeves.

events.did: kept his hand on the panel twice as long as warned, to make sure the fallen soldiers were dead
events.quote_anchor: but Gabriel remembered Helena’s warning and kept his hand on the panel twice as long. To make sure they were dead.

events.did: held out the tablet for Gabriel to see the soldiers' biometric readings
events.quote_anchor: When he asked, she held it out for him to see the soldiers’ biometric readings.

events.did: dragged the fallen soldiers back from death one by one, and under his control
events.quote_anchor: Wake up, he thought, resting a hand on their shoulder, feeling the cold against his palm. One by one, he dragged them back from death. And under his control.

events.did: bled from the nose, staggered against a table, called for Helena, and collapsed before he could finish the sentence
events.quote_anchor: But before he could find the words, the world gave way, and Gabriel Gray went down, his world collapsing into black.

relations.did: speaks through Helena Roy's lips and voice, making her deliver his words to the board
relations.quote_anchor: Gabriel’s words came out from Helena Roy’s lips, in Helena Roy’s voice,

relations.did: is the Director Roy who addresses the EON board on the screen call
relations.quote_anchor: “DIRECTOR Roy,” said the woman on the screen, “this is highly unusual.”

relations.did: brought the twelve soldiers back from death and kept them under his control
relations.quote_anchor: One by one, he dragged them back from death. And under his control.

relations.did: was challenged by a board member in a charcoal suit about who he was
relations.quote_anchor: “No offense, Dr. Gray,” said a man in a charcoal suit. “But who the hell are you?”

numbers.did: is described as four remaining members assembled on the wall behind Helena Roy's desk
numbers.quote_anchor: The four remaining members of the board were assembled on the wall behind her desk.

numbers.did: are described as three men and two women, each wearing a different shade of gray
numbers.quote_anchor: Three men, and two women, each wearing a different shade of gray, and a version of the same disgruntlement.

numbers.did: has five members who would have to be persuaded after Gabriel Gray took over
numbers.quote_anchor: Of course, now, the five members of the board would have to be persuaded.

numbers.did: number a dozen, lying where they had fallen
numbers.quote_anchor: A dozen soldiers lay where they’d fallen, draped across the canteen tables, and sprawled on the floor like the product of some bloodless massacre.

numbers.did: have twelve minds ready to be converted to Gabriel's cause
numbers.quote_anchor: Twelve minds, ready to be converted to his cause.

numbers.who: the soldiers' collapse in the canteen
numbers.did: took less than a minute for the soldiers to go down
numbers.quote_anchor: It had taken less than a minute for the soldiers to go down, but Gabriel remembered Helena’s warning and kept his hand on the panel twice as long.
